import asyncio
import json
import os
import uuid

import httpx

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8686"
API_KEY = $SECRET"CLOUD_API_KEY"]
URL = "https://kiongroup.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/KionGroup/job/Atlanta-Georgia/Senior-Software-Engineer_R4814"


async def main() -> None:
    payload = {
        "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "url": URL,
        "executor_backend": "playwright",
        "execution_host": "local",
        "controls": [],
        "profile_data": {},
        "debug_enabled": True,
    }
    headers = {"X-API-Key": API_KEY, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
        async with client.stream(
            "POST", f"{BASE}/api/agent/stream", json=payload, headers=headers
        ) as response:
            print("HTTP", response.status_code)
            seen = set()
            async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                if not line:
                    continue
                for token in (
                    "application_entry",
                    "model_decision",
                    "browser_auth",
                    "RUN_PAUSED",
                    "navigation",
                    "checkpoint",
                ):
                    if token in line and token not in seen:
                        seen.add(token)
                        print("SIG:", line[:240])
                if "application_entry" in line or "RUN_PAUSED" in line:
                    print("FULL:", line[:400])


asyncio.run(main())
